children: Bhageria will take over as Chief Financial Officer on 1 January 2027, following the superannuation of incumbent Group CFO Shashidhar SK on 31 December 2026

AXISCADES Technologies has appointed Uttam Kumar Bhageria as Chief Financial Officer (CFO)-Designate, effective 21 October 2026. He will take over as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) on 1 January 2027, following the superannuation of the current Group Chief Financial Officer and KMP, Shashidhar SK, on 31 December 2026.
The appointment was recommended by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee and the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on 16 October 2026.

Bhageria will serve as CFO-Designate until 31 December 2026, before assuming the CFO role on 1 January 2027. The transition period will allow for a handover ahead of Shashidhar SK’s superannuation at the end of December.
Bhageria has more than two decades of experience in strategic finance across listed companies, multinational organisations and promoter-led businesses.

His professional background includes leading an acquisition valued at Rs 3,000 crore, driving a fivefold increase in market capitalisation through strategic initiatives, and managing corporate restructuring and capital market activities.
He has also worked with global consulting firms BCG and McKinsey on transformation and diversification projects.
The appointment was disclosed under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
According to the disclosure, Bhageria is not related to any existing director of the company. The board meeting on 16 October commenced at 4:30 pm IST and concluded at 5:00 pm IST.
